title: Hreflang Check
description: Stops Google from silently ignoring hreflang by checking pasted <link> tags or a sitemap for one page or a whole set the way Search Central describes, with a who-links-to-whom grid, and flagging missing or near-miss return links, invalid codes like en-UK or es-419, relative URLs, a missing self-reference or x-default and a canonical that points at another language's page, each with a one-tap fix.
